_instructions: Presentation only; does not grant permissions or enable unavailable V3 features. Edit this file and publish assets; adopted on page reload. common is deeply merged with desktop/mobile/widget; arrays and scalars replace. chat.json retains only surrounding header placement/sizing. Set menu actions false to hide them; a rename-only menu sets all other menu action flags false.

trigger._instructions: agent_icon, session_name and status show avatar, title and existing activity/unread counter. row_actions shows the optional More button. archive shows direct archive.

menu._instructions: default_rows limits visible rows before scrolling (1–100); viewport can show fewer. agent_icons/session_name/status control row contents. row_actions shows optional row More buttons. All action flags control visibility only. always_on_display controls Screen display. archive archives an active session; unarchive/delete (permanent) control archived-session actions.

footer._instructions: enabled hides/shows the entire dropdown footer. Each child independently controls its current footer feature. archived toggles the archived-sessions view. batch_archive includes checkbox mode and its archive-selected control.

gestures._instructions: Open the same action menu on trigger or session rows. Keyboard ContextMenu or Shift+F10 remains available. Long press cancels on movement, scrolling, pointer cancellation, release or teardown.
